$comment: Reviewed catalog of EventBus pipeline agents. Togglable entries may be started/stopped from Mission Control. Always-on entries cannot be operator-disabled (RiskEngine/OMS/ChiefTrader/exits/market data). Not a UI knob for thresholds.

togglableIdeaAgents.label: News
togglableIdeaAgents.description: News TRADE_IDEA_GENERATED when desk policy allows. Cluster ingest for RiskEngine news_veto runs from process boot (independent of Autobot); ideas stay gated.

togglableIdeaAgents.label: Kronos
togglableIdeaAgents.description: Local Chronos forecasts on MARKET_DATA for research/UI; TRADE_IDEA_GENERATED only when Autobot/idea gate allows. Starts at process boot (independent of Autobot); ideas stay fail-closed when Chronos /health is down.

alwaysOn.label: Chief Trader
alwaysOn.reason: Consensus must stay on whenever Autobot is on so remaining agent ideas still go through weighted debate. Not an entry generator.

alwaysOn.label: Risk Engine
alwaysOn.reason: Operator must not disable RiskEngine. Every approved idea still evaluates every gate.

alwaysOn.label: Order Management
alwaysOn.reason: OMS is the only order path. Disabling it from a lamp would leave approvals with nowhere honest to go.

alwaysOn.label: Portfolio exits
alwaysOn.reason: Take-profit / trailing-stop / thesis-invalidation SELLs are capital preservation, not entry votes.

alwaysOn.label: Market data
alwaysOn.reason: Price feed stays up so RiskEngine and Diagnostics have live ticks even when idea agents are off.
